lines.text: Moses saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, struck him down, and hid his body in the sand.
Pharaoh sought to kill Moses, so Moses fled and settled in the land of Moab.
Moses sat beside a well, and when shepherds drove away the priest of Midian's seven daughters, he watered their flock.
Their father Reuel told them to invite Moses to eat, and he gave his daughter Rebekah to Moses in marriage.
After the king of Egypt died, the Israelites cried out, and God heard their groaning and remembered His covenant.
